# Tokenization Request Validation

## 1. Card data
- `card.pan`: string, 13–19 digits after stripping spaces and dashes. Must pass Luhn.
- `card.exp_month`: integer 1–12.
- `card.exp_year`: integer, four digits.
- Expiry must not be in the past relative to request time (end of expiry month).
- Expiry must not be more than 5 years in the future.

## 2. Security
- Raw CVV keys (`cvv`, `cvc`, `security_code`, case-insensitive) must be rejected at any depth.
- Maximum nesting depth: 6 levels.

## 3. Billing address
- `card.billing.address.line1`: required, non-empty after trim.
- `card.billing.address.line2`: optional.
- `city`: required.
- `postal_code`: required.
- `country`: required, ISO 3166-1 alpha-2.
- Strings are NFC-normalized. Control characters (Unicode category Cc) rejected.

## 4. Metadata and token_policy
- `metadata`: object, optional, string values only, max 20 keys.
- `token_policy`: object, required. `token_policy.ttl_days` integer 1–365. `token_policy.single_use` boolean.

## Errors
All failures raise `ValidationError(path, message)` where `path` is a dotted field path.
